desc: Rester av julematen ble brettet i biter, kokt og spist sammen med det siste juleølet.

sources.citation: Musea i Nord-Østerdalen, "Merkedager jula og januar"

notes: Named for the little-known Celtic saint Brictiva, martyred by axe — hence the axe icon (SNL's primstav table lists the carved symbol as 'Kors, hake, strek', of which the axe/hake element is the most distinctive). SNL's primstav table also lists a weather-lore function (morning weather predicts March, afternoon predicts April) not included in `desc` to keep it to one sentence — worth adding if the schema grows a secondary-lore field later. Merged into FIXED/ICONS in all three HTML files 2026-08-18.
